cache_policy.baseline_control: eligible for control baseline cache when the exact manifest, model, base tools, and cache hash are recorded
cache_policy.sage_candidate_arms: fresh experimental runs only; no prior SAGE traces as outcome evidence
cache_policy.cross_arm_response_reuse: disabled unless the cache key is provably arm/tool/registry specific and recorded in the run report

leakage_controls: Seed/dev base families are excluded from all unseen splits.
No scenario is assigned to more than one split.
Unseen split truth labels are marked not inspected.
Cache availability is not used as a scenario-selection feature.
Scenario IDs may not be hard-coded into generated tools or routers.

seed_dev_labeled.diversity_reason: Selected by seeded round-robin over primary task labels and base task families, with at most 1 scenarios from any base family in this split.

pilot_unseen.diversity_reason: Selected by seeded round-robin over primary task labels and base task families, with at most 2 scenarios from any base family in this split.

expanded_pilot_unseen.diversity_reason: Selected by seeded round-robin over primary task labels and base task families, with at most 3 scenarios from any base family in this split.

confirm_unseen.diversity_reason: Selected by seeded round-robin over primary task labels and base task families, with at most 4 scenarios from any base family in this split.

scale_unseen.diversity_reason: Selected by seeded round-robin over primary task labels and base task families, with at most 6 scenarios from any base family in this split.
